title: dryopsis ferruginea
intro: Dryopsis ferruginea, commonly known as Rusty Wood Fern, is a species of fern native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and digestive problems. The health benefits of Dryopsis ferruginea include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve sleep quality, and alleviate stress, thanks to its therapeutic actions such as sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
